facts.text: Centering its mission on Mark 10:45 ('not to be served, but to serve'), Ozark Christian College requires all undergraduate degree candidates to take a foundational core of Bible classes.

sources.title: table of contents - My OCC - Ozark Christian College
sources.quote: A theme verse for our college is Mark 10:45—“not to be served, but to serve .” At OCC, you'll catch a greater vision for reaching out to others with the love and truth of Christ

sources.title: table of contents - My OCC - Ozark Christian College
sources.quote: Our curriculum backs our commitment—every graduate takes a strong core of top-notch Bible classes .
